reschedule.title: Manage ad visibility
reschedule.subtitle: Choose how the ad appears to users; you can change scheduling anytime.

immediate.label: Go live immediately (no schedule)
immediate.description: Visible to visitors while enabled here, with no start or end time.

scheduled.label: Schedule specific times
scheduled.description: Set a start and/or end time for visibility.

paused.label: Pause ad
paused.description: Hidden from users until you turn it on again.

reschedule.outcomeImmediate: Result: The ad will appear immediately and stay visible while enabled, with no start or end schedule.
reschedule.outcomeHidden: Result: The ad will be hidden from users.
reschedule.outcomeRange: Result: The ad will show from {{start}} until {{end}}.
reschedule.outcomeFrom: Result: The ad will start on {{start}} with no end date.
reschedule.outcomeUntil: Result: The ad will appear immediately and end on {{end}}.
reschedule.outcomeDefault: Result: The ad will appear immediately with no end date.
reschedule.startHint: Leave start empty to begin immediately.
reschedule.endHint: Leave end empty for no end date.
reschedule.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be before start date.
reschedule.endInPast: Warning: end date is in the past, so the ad will show as expired and will not appear to users.

popup.empty: No popup ads yet. Create a new one.
popup.selectHint: Select an ad from the list or click New ad to create one.
popup.firstLoginHint: For signed-in users only. Shown once after login; not shown again after dismiss or view. Not shown to guests.
popup.firstLoginGuests: With audience "Guests only", this ad will not appear.
popup.everyLoginHint: For signed-in users only. Shown after each login, not again in the same session after dismiss. Not shown to guests.
popup.hint1: Only one ad is shown at a time, by order.
popup.hint2: After close, the display frequency setting is respected (session / day / visit / first login / every login).
popup.hint3: With "First login only", the ad shows once after the user's first login and never again after dismiss or view.
popup.hint4: With "Every login", the ad shows after each login and not again in the same session after dismiss.
popup.hint5: Audience is based on user role or guest status.
popup.hint6: Display can be scheduled with start and end dates.
